$comment: WHAT AN ESTIMATION MANIFEST LOOKS LIKE, declared here so no format fact lives in code (lib/handlers/estimation-manifest.js reads this and nothing else about the format). EPAM_ESTIMATION_MANIFEST names a file or a directory; for each ingested ticket the handler finds that ticket's entry, keeps the declared sections, and persists one record per ticket under $LOG_DIR/estimation/. Operator, 2026-09-28: estimation manifests will commonly inform the brownfield pipeline — a new source is an edit here.

html.$why: The estimation application's per-story page (ai-estimate-story-<KEY>.html). Hand-authored pages vary in their headings (AMSD-1494 vs AMSD-2974), so sections are chosen by heading TEXT, case-insensitive, and a section runs to the next heading of the same or a higher level. A page none of these match is reported, never passed on empty.

sections.heading: code assessment
sections.label: Code assessment — findings in the source

sections.heading: rewritten into|rewrote them into|as testable statements
sections.label: Criteria rewritten as testable statements

json.$why: The estimation engine's manifest, keyed by ticket (pi12-engine-estimates-*.json). Every field of the ticket's entry is kept; these are the ones rendered first, in this order.
